description: Enterprise policy for Marksmith Connector AI-usage governance. Push via Intune/GPO/managed storage. Leave orgMode false (default) for personal use — governance is fully opt-in.

orgMode.description: Enable transparent AI-usage governance. When true, employees see a one-time consent notice and a persistent on-screen monitoring indicator on AI chat sites.

orgName.description: Organization name shown to employees in the consent notice and monitoring badge.

orgId.description: Opaque organization identifier used to scope stored consent.

collectorUrl.description: Base URL of the governance collector (the Marksmith app or a central service). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:47821.

userId.description: Identity to attribute events to (typically populated from SSO/device enrollment).

userEmail.description: Employee work email, if the org attributes by email.

policyUrl.description: Link to the organization's AI-usage / monitoring policy, shown in the consent notice.
